phone.changelog: v2.10.0: Share the actual Google Maps phone screen to your watch over Bluetooth. Open Device > Google Maps on watch and approve Android screen sharing each time. Keep the phone unlocked with Maps visible. Update both apps to 2.10.0; images refresh about every 1.5 seconds or slower.

watch.changelog: v2.10.0: Open Apps > Live phone map for the real Google Maps phone view. Full-screen layout with round-safe controls, Fit, pinch zoom, pan and Help. Share from the updated phone app first. Stale images are hidden; stopping, locking the phone or disconnecting ends sharing.
